fields.name: remaining_targets
fields.description: The list of highlighted cubes not yet successfully picked up, represented by their table-center coordinates [y, x]. Before the button-reveal interval has been observed, use null rather than an empty list. At the decision immediately following the button press, populate the list by matching every white highlighted area seen during that interval to its cube; store cube centers, not highlight centers. Order targets by image columns from smaller x to larger x; cubes whose x coordinates differ by at most 10 pixels count as the same column and are ordered by increasing y. At each decision following a successful pickup, remove the picked cube. Do not remove a cube merely because a pickup was commanded, and do not restore it when placed down. Preserve remaining coordinates through occlusion and minor centroid wobble. Thus episode 6 has null, [[89, 146], [63, 150]], [[63, 150]], [[63, 150]]; episode 28 has null, [[64, 91]]; episode 38 has null, [[81, 125], [113, 120]], [[113, 120]], [[113, 120]]; episode 57 has null, [[84, 92]]; episode 98 has null, [[99, 104], [112, 146]], [[112, 146]], [[112, 146]]. e.g. [[63, 150]]
